problems.title: Inradius of a narrow isosceles triangle
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has legs 13 and base 24. Find its inradius.
problems.idea: Use the altitude, then area divided by semiperimeter.

problems.title: A substitution reveals an impossible equation
problems.question: How many real solutions satisfy (√(x²+7)−1)²+(√(x²+7)−1)−1=0?
problems.idea: Bound the substituted expression before solving.
steps: For t>1, t²+t−1>1, so it cannot be zero.

problems.title: A quadratic with √2 coefficients
problems.question: Which listed number solves √2x²+4x+√2=0?
problems.idea: Divide by √2 and apply the quadratic formula.

problems.title: Circumradius from an altitude and its projections
problems.question: In acute ABC, BD⊥AC, BD=12, AD=5, CD=9. Find the circumradius.
problems.idea: Find AB,BC by Pythagoras and use R=abc/(4Δ).

problems.title: Count integers in a system
problems.question: How many integers solve 7(x−1)−2x>9−3x and 3(5−2x)−1≥4−5x?
problems.idea: Simplify the inequalities separately.
formulas: First: 8x>16, so x>2. Second: 14−6x≥4−5x, so x≤10.

problems.title: Divide powers of rational monomials
problems.question: For x,y>199, simplify (−27x³/(16y⁵))² ÷ (9x²/(8y³))³.
problems.idea: Apply exponent rules and cancel common powers.

problems.title: Sum squared sines in a right triangle
problems.question: A right triangle has an acute angle 10°. Find the sum of squares of the sines of all three angles.
problems.idea: The acute angles are complementary.

problems.title: The square root of a square
problems.question: Solve √(x²−6x+9)=3−x.
problems.idea: The root is an absolute value.
steps: For x≤3, |x−3|=3−x, so every such x works.
For x>3, the right side is negative, so none work.

problems.title: An inequality in one absolute value
problems.question: Solve |x−1|−(|x−1|+1)/2≤(|x−1|−1)/3.
problems.idea: Substitute t=|x−1| and clear positive denominators.

problems.title: Factor before substituting decimals
problems.question: Evaluate (x²+9x+18)/(xy−2x+3y−6)−(x+5)/(y−2) at x=3.9,y=2.1.
problems.idea: Factor both parts of the first fraction.

problems.title: A median perpendicular to a side
problems.question: BM is a median in ABC, BM⊥BC, and AB=2BC. Find cosC.
problems.idea: Place BC on a coordinate axis.
steps: The horizontal projection of CA toward B is 2c, so cosC=2c/(√7c).

problems.title: Roots in a ratio
problems.question: The roots of x²+20x+a=0 are in ratio 3:7. Find a.
problems.idea: Use their sum to determine the common multiplier.
steps: Thus t=−2 and the roots are −6,−14.

problems.title: Dilution halves a concentration
problems.question: A solution contains 20 g salt. Adding 100 g water halves its salt concentration. Find the original percentage.
problems.idea: The solution’s total mass must double.

problems.title: Check all five proposed inequalities
problems.question: For positive a,b, determine which is false: harmonic≤geometric mean, geometric≤arithmetic mean, arithmetic≤quadratic mean, a²+b²−ab≥0, or a+4/a≥4.
problems.idea: Each follows from a square or the arithmetic-geometric mean inequality.
steps: Arithmetic≤quadratic follows by squaring and using (a−b)²≥0.
a²+b²−ab=(a−b)²+ab>0. The remaining two are the displayed AM-GM inequalities.
problems.answer: All five are true; choose the option saying all preceding inequalities are true.

problems.title: A side difference and the sine rule
problems.question: In ABC, A=60°, B=45°, and BC−AC=9(√(3/2)−1). Find AC.
problems.idea: Use the ratio of sides opposite the given angles.
steps: The nonzero factor cancels against the given difference.

problems.title: Simplify a radical with negative variables
problems.question: Simplify (b+√(ab))/√(−b) over the reals.
problems.idea: The denominator forces b<0, and ab≥0 then forces a≤0.

problems.title: The sine between two segments in a square
problems.question: In square ABCD, AP:PB=3:2 and AQ:QC=4:1, with P on AB and Q on AC. Find sinPDQ.
problems.idea: Use the determinant formula for the sine between vectors.

problems.title: A necessary relation from triangle sides
problems.question: Positive a,b give triangle sides a+5b,5a+6b,3a+2b. Which relation must hold?
problems.idea: Apply the triangle inequality to the largest side.
steps: This gives a<b. The other two triangle inequalities are automatic for positive a,b.

problems.title: When is a rational polynomial an integer?
problems.question: How many integers n make (n³−3n²+2n−3)/(n²+2) an integer?
problems.idea: Use polynomial division to isolate the remainder.
steps: The positive integer n²+2 must divide 3, so it must be 3.

problems.title: When a rational equation has no solution
problems.question: For how many b does [x(2b+1)−b]/[x(x−1)]=0 have no solution?
problems.idea: A valid zero needs a zero numerator with x≠0,1.
formulas: If 2b+1≠0, the only candidate is x=b/(2b+1).
steps: At b=−1/2 the numerator is constant 1/2, so there is no root.
At b=0 the candidate is excluded x=0. At b=−1 the candidate is excluded x=1.
All other b give one valid root.

problems.title: An incircle tangent to a trapezoid leg
problems.question: The longer leg of a right tangential trapezoid is divided at tangency into 8 cm and 50 cm. Find its inradius.
problems.idea: Use equal tangent lengths from each vertex and the right-angle corners.
formulas: Longer leg=58; height=2r; bases are r+8 and r+50.
steps: Pythagoras on the sloping leg gives 58²=42²+(2r)².

problems.title: A sum of two distances
problems.question: Solve |x−7|+|x+1|≤8.
problems.idea: The sum is at least the distance between −1 and 7.
steps: Equality occurs exactly when x lies between the endpoints.
Outside that interval the sum is strictly larger than 8.

problems.title: Two roots for every parameter
problems.question: Find all a for which √(x²−a−2)=√|a+1| has two distinct real solutions.
problems.idea: Square the nonnegative sides and examine the right side.
steps: For a≥−1 the right side is 2a+3≥1. For a<−1 it is 1.
It is always positive, giving two distinct roots ±√(a+2+|a+1|).
At those roots the original radicand equals |a+1|, so both are valid.

problems.title: Similar triangles from a secant identity
problems.question: A circle through A,C crosses AB,BC at M,N. AM=MB, BN:NC=2:7, AC=4.8. Find MN.
problems.idea: Use the power of B, then find a similarity with swapped sides.
steps: BM/BC=1/3 and BN/BA=1/3. The included angle at B is common, so BMN and BCA are similar.

problems.title: Area between two absolute-value graphs
problems.question: Find the area satisfying y≥|x−1| and y≤4−|x|.
problems.idea: Break the vertical gap at x=0 and x=1.
steps: The graphs meet at x=−3/2 and x=5/2.
From −3/2 to 0 the region is a triangle of base 3/2,height 3: area 9/4. From 0 to 1 it is a rectangle of area 3.
From 1 to 5/2 is another triangle of area 9/4. Total=9/4+3+9/4.
